title: Access handback + FinOps & SOC 2 playbook sync — notes (v2)
context_source: Consolidated notes based on 2026-10-19 call + follow-ups through 2026-10-28. This doc supersedes earlier ad-hoc meeting capture; keep this as the working source for auditors/readiness.
summary: Cross-functional sync to coordinate the platform access handback from infra contractors, confirm KMS rotation windows, run a FinOps spike triage, and align on SOC 2 evidence + playbook artifacts for readiness. Since the 10/19 sync: staging rotation dry-run completed successfully (1 transient auth failure observed and mitigated), RBAC diff export produced, and FinOps root cause narrowed to autoscaling + one-time reindex job (billing spike revised from ~12% to ~9.6% after removing duplicate cost attribution). Remaining work focuses on production rotation scheduling, final evidence packaging (immutable logs + checksums), and closing contractor account cleanup with a defined grace period.
body:
Attendees (internal):
- Jordan Blake (AE)
- Priya Nair (SE)
- Evan McCoy (Platform Ops)

Customer / stakeholders (internal IT/FinOps/Security):
- Lena Morris (IT Manager)
- Marcus Lee (Finance Ops)
- Samir Patel (Security Engineer)
- Rosa Chen (Compliance)

Original agenda (from 10/19): handback timeline, KMS/key rotation, FinOps billing spike, SOC 2 artifacts mapping, on-call ownership.

What stayed the same (still required):
- Platform access handback: ensure no leftover service accounts/keys from contractors; validate RBAC mappings post-handback.
- KMS/HSM rotation: rotate keys with change control; capture evidence (logs, timestamps, revocation proof).
- SOC 2 evidence: immutable logs preferred, zipped exports + checksums, clear naming conventions, approver identity + time.
- FinOps: correlate deployment/orchestration events with billing spikes; produce a short one-pager.
- Ops hygiene: define rollback criteria, no-deploy window, and budget guardrails during rotation.

Updates since the 10/19 capture (v2 delta):
1) SOC 2 playbook location updated
- Old draft link circulated in the meeting notes is no longer the active working doc.
- Current working link: https://internal.redwood/docs/security/soc2-playbook
- Playbook is being reorganized around: (a) key rotation schedule/evidence, (b) access control/RBAC diffs, (c) change approvals, (d) rollback criteria narrative.

2) Staging KMS rotation dry-run results (executed 2026-10-19 22:00 PST)
- Completed with logs exported and archived.
- Notable issue: 1 service did not gracefully retry token exchange during the cutover; mitigation was to temporarily route to read-only mode during the test.
- Evidence output: zipped log bundle + SHA-256 checksum recorded for artifact tracker; avoid screenshots unless paired with logs.

3) FinOps billing spike triage updated
- Initial estimate discussed in meeting: ~12% October uplift.
- Revised after follow-up attribution cleanup: ~9.6% uplift for the Oct 3 week.
- Current suspected drivers:
  - GPU autoscaling parameter change mid-deploy (confirmed)
  - One-time reindex job increased GPU-hours + minor disk egress (confirmed)
  - Contractor activity overlap likely incidental; not the primary driver (tentative)
- Actionable mitigation: add spend cap alerting during rotation windows; document expected rollback cost impact in change tickets.

4) Handback / service account cleanup approach clarified
- Ops (Evan) owns cleanup plan.
- 72-hour grace period retained, but now requires an explicit exception note + business owner sign-off per account.

5) On-call / escalation clarified
- IT: basic access issues
- Platform Ops: runtime alerts + rotation execution
- Compliance: escalation path for suspicious access patterns and evidence gaps
- Security: severity 1 access breaches

Evidence packaging conventions (auditor-friendly):
- Use prefixes: project + YYYY-MM-DD + environment + artifact type
  Example: "redwood-platform-2026-10-19-staging-kms-rotation-logs.zip"
- Include:
  - checksum file (sha256)
  - provenance metadata (who generated, from which system, timestamps)
  - approver identity + timestamp captured from change ticket

Risks + mitigations (current view):
- Risk: resource contention during rotation window if hot redeploys occur
  - Mitigation: enforce a 'no deploys' freeze window in the scheduling ticket
- Risk: unexpected egress / GPU usage during prove-out
  - Mitigation: temporary budget guardrail (targeted $500/day was proposed; final threshold to be confirmed by FinOps)
- Risk: services lacking retry behavior
  - Mitigation: pre-identify those services; use read-only routing and runbook rollback criteria

Open questions (still pending as of 10/28):
- Confirm production rotation date/time that satisfies both change-freeze and audit evidence timing.
- Confirm final spend cap threshold for the production window (FinOps sign-off).
- Confirm Vault policy review completion for evidence pipeline access (least privilege) and retention settings for immutable logs.
decisions: Staging rotation evidence must be logs-first (immutable storage) with zipped exports + checksums; screenshots only as supplemental.
Platform Ops owns contractor service account cleanup with a 72-hour grace period; exceptions require explicit business owner sign-off.
Freeze window ('no deploys') will be enforced during production rotation.
FinOps one-pager should include correlated deploy IDs + scale events + billing line items; revised spike estimate is ~9.6% after attribution cleanup.
